title.zh: Three.js 是怎么把一个场景画出来的

desc.zh: 二十行代码就能让一个立方体在网页里转起来，最后那一行 renderer.render(scene, camera) 每秒跑六十次。这篇按 three.js r187 的源码，把这一行拆开：场景树和矩阵，几何体的字节，相机和深度，剔除和排序，材质怎么变成着色器，一个像素的颜色，光栅化，纹理，阴影，draw call 的开销，拾取和四元数，以及 WebGPU。十几个可以动手的模型，都用页面里重写的同一套算法，并和 three.js 本身逐项对过数。
desc.en: A spinning cube in a web page takes twenty lines, and the last one, renderer.render(scene, camera), runs sixty times a second. Following the three.js r187 source, this essay takes that line apart: the scene tree and its matrices, the bytes of a geometry, the camera and depth, culling and sorting, how a material becomes a shader, the colour of one pixel, rasterisation, textures, shadows, what a draw call costs, picking and quaternions, and WebGPU. A dozen hands-on models run the same algorithms, rewritten in the page and checked number by number against three.js itself.

desc.zh: Three.js 自己不画像素：它决定发哪些绘制命令、按什么顺序、带什么状态，再经 WebGL 或 WebGPU、浏览器和驱动交给 GPU。
desc.en: Three.js draws no pixels itself: it decides which draw calls to issue, in what order and with what state, and hands them through WebGL or WebGPU, the browser and the driver to the GPU.

title.en: The scene graph and world matrices

desc.zh: 每个 Object3D 存相对父节点的位置、四元数和缩放；世界矩阵是从根一路乘下来的。默认每一帧每个节点都重算一遍，render 之前读到的是上一帧的值。
desc.en: Each Object3D stores position, quaternion and scale relative to its parent; its world matrix is the product down from the root. By default every node is recomputed every frame, and reading it before render gives last frame's value.

title.zh: 几何体：顶点、索引和字节

desc.zh: BufferGeometry 是一组类型化数组：位置、法线、uv 和索引。一个立方体有 24 个顶点，因为每个角在三个面上法线不同；每个顶点 32 字节。
desc.en: A BufferGeometry is a set of typed arrays: position, normal, uv and an index. A cube has 24 vertices because each corner has a different normal on each of its three faces; each vertex is 32 bytes.

zh: 立方体为什么有 24 个顶点
en: why does a cube have 24 vertices

title.zh: 投影、裁剪空间和深度精度
title.en: Projection, clip space and depth precision

desc.zh: 一个点经视图矩阵、投影矩阵、除以 w 和视口变换变成像素和深度。深度不均匀：近平面附近用掉了大部分格子，远处的两个面会抢同一个深度，这就是 z-fighting。
desc.en: A point becomes a pixel and a depth through the view matrix, the projection matrix, the divide by w and the viewport. Depth is not uniform: most values go near the near plane, so far-away surfaces share a depth and z-fight.

title.zh: 视锥体剔除和渲染顺序

desc.zh: render() 用包围球和视锥体的六个面剔除看不见的物体，再把不透明的按材质、由近到远排，透明的由远到近排。
desc.en: render() culls objects with bounding spheres against the six frustum planes, then sorts opaque objects by material and near to far, and transparent ones far to near.

title.zh: 材质怎么变成着色器程序
title.en: How a material becomes a shader program

desc.zh: 材质是参数；three.js 把着色器片段和 #define 拼成程序，用一长串参数当钥匙缓存。灯的数量在每个钥匙里，加一盏灯所有材质都要重新编译。
desc.en: A material is parameters; three.js assembles a program from shader chunks and #defines and caches it under a long key. Light counts are in every key, so adding a light recompiles every material.

desc.zh: 高光是 GGX 分布、相关形式的 Smith 遮挡和 Schlick 菲涅尔的乘积，漫反射是剩下的光；粗糙的表面单次散射会丢能量，three.js 查表补回来。
desc.en: Specular is the product of the GGX distribution, correlated Smith visibility and Schlick Fresnel; diffuse is what remains. Rough surfaces lose energy to single scattering, and three.js adds it back from a table.

title.zh: 光栅化、深度测试和透明排序
title.en: Rasterisation, the depth test and transparency

desc.zh: GPU 用边函数判断像素中心在不在三角形里，用重心坐标做透视校正插值，用深度缓冲区决定谁在前面。透明靠混合，和顺序有关，互相穿过的透明物体怎么排都不对。
desc.en: The GPU tests pixel centres with edge functions, interpolates with perspective-correct barycentrics and keeps the nearest surface with a depth buffer. Transparency blends in order, so intersecting transparent objects cannot be sorted right.

title.zh: 纹理过滤、mipmap 和颜色空间
title.en: Texture filtering, mipmaps and colour space

desc.zh: 远处一个像素盖住很多纹理像素，所以 GPU 按 λ = log₂ρ 选 mipmap 的级别；各向异性过滤沿长的方向多采几次。mipmap 多占三分之一显存；颜色贴图要设成 sRGB。
desc.en: Far away, a pixel covers many texels, so the GPU picks a mip level λ = log₂ρ; anisotropic filtering takes more samples along the long axis. Mipmaps add a third to memory; colour maps must be marked sRGB.

desc.zh: 阴影贴图是从灯的位置画的一张深度图。它一格一格的，所以受光面会自己挡自己出现条纹，bias 太大阴影又会和物体分开。
desc.en: A shadow map is a depth image rendered from the light. It is made of texels, so lit surfaces shadow themselves in stripes, and too much bias detaches the shadow from the object.

title.zh: draw call 的开销和实例化
title.en: What a draw call costs, and instancing

desc.zh: 每个网格至少一次 draw call，每次都要在 CPU 上切换状态、上传参数、经过浏览器检查。物体一多 CPU 先撑不住；合并、InstancedMesh 和 BatchedMesh 把 N 次变成 1 次。
desc.en: Each mesh is at least one draw call, and each costs CPU time for state, uniforms and the browser's checks. With many objects the CPU gives out first; merging, InstancedMesh and BatchedMesh turn N calls into one.

desc.zh: Raycaster 从相机穿过鼠标发一条射线，先和包围球比，再逐个三角形测试（r187 用水密的边函数测试），命中按距离排序。
desc.en: The Raycaster shoots a ray from the camera through the mouse, tests the bounding sphere first and then every triangle (r187 uses a watertight edge-function test), and sorts hits by distance.

desc.zh: 旋转用四元数存：两个朝向之间的 slerp 走最短的弧、匀速；把欧拉角分别插值会绕远路，还有万向节锁。
desc.en: Rotations are stored as quaternions: slerp between two orientations follows the shortest arc at constant speed; interpolating Euler angles takes a longer path and suffers gimbal lock.

title.zh: WebGPU 和 three.js 的新渲染器
title.en: WebGPU and the new three.js renderer

desc.zh: WebGPU 是更接近 Metal、Vulkan、Direct3D 12 的网页图形接口，能做通用计算；three.js 的 WebGPURenderer 和 TSL 节点材质正在接手。截至 2026 年 11 月各浏览器的支持情况。
desc.en: WebGPU is a web graphics API closer to Metal, Vulkan and Direct3D 12, with general compute; three.js's WebGPURenderer and TSL node materials are taking over. Browser support as of November 2026.
